record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For 1 ≤ r ≤ 2, let P_{r,2} be the ideal of (r,2)-summing operators, and let (P_{r,2})APP_{r,∞} be the operator ideal from Theorem 2.4. Determine whether every trace on (P_{r,2})APP_{r,∞} is one of the traces constructed in Theorem 2.4, so that no additional traces exist on this ideal.

evidence.quote: Concerning the basics about P_{r,2}, the ideal of (r, 2)-summing operators ...
Theorem 2.4. ... This definition yields a trace ϕ_{r,∞}(· |P_{r,2}) on (P_{r,2})APP_{r,∞}.
Problem 10. Show that on (P_{r,2})APP_{r,∞} there exist no other traces than those provided by Theorem 2.4.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $1 \le r \le 2$. Recall that a (bounded linear) operator $T : X \to Y$ between Banach spaces is called $(r,2)$-summing if there is a constant $c \ge 0$ such that for every finite family $x_1,\dots,x_n \in X$ one has
$$\Bigl(\sum_{k=1}^n \|Tx_k\|^r\Bigr)^{1/r} \le c \sup_{\|x^*\|\le 1}\Bigl(\sum_{k=1}^n |\langle x_k, x^*\rangle|^2\Bigr)^{1/2}.$$
The class of all such operators forms a Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}$.

For an operator $T \in \mathcal{L}(X,Y)$ with approximation numbers $a_n(T) := \inf\{\|T-A\| : A \in \mathcal{L}(X,Y),\ \mathrm{rank}(A)<n\}$, define the ideal $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}^{\mathrm{APP}}{}_{r,\infty}$ to consist of those operators $T$ which factor as $T = AB$ with $B \in \mathfrak{P}_{r,2}$ and $A$ in the approximation ideal $\mathcal{L}^{(\mathrm{app})}_{r,\infty}$, i.e. $\sup_{n\ge 1} n^{1/r} a_n(A) < \infty$ (equivalently the natural composition of the Banach ideals $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}$ and $\mathcal{L}^{(\mathrm{app})}_{r,\infty}$).

A trace on an operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}$ defined on the class of all Banach spaces is a linear functional $\tau$ on the components $\mathfrak{A}(X,X)$ ($X$ Banach) such that:
(i) $\tau(x^* \otimes x) = \langle x, x^*\rangle$ for every rank-one operator,
(ii) $\tau(BA) = \tau(AB)$ whenever $A \in \mathfrak{A}(X,Y)$, $B \in \mathcal{L}(Y,X)$.

For each $1 \le r \le 2$ there is a canonical construction producing a trace $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\,\cdot\,|\mathfrak{P}_{r,2})$ on $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}^{\mathrm{APP}}{}_{r,\infty}$ obtained from a dilation/averaging procedure applied to the ideal $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}$ (one such trace for each suitable Banach limit / dilation-invariant mean).

Problem. Prove that every trace on the operator ideal $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}^{\mathrm{APP}}{}_{r,\infty}$ is of the form $\varphi_{r,\infty}(\,\cdot\,|\mathfrak{P}_{r,2})$ produced by this construction; equivalently, show that no other traces exist on this ideal.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the literature on traces on operator ideals defined over the class of all Banach spaces. A web search did not surface any subsequent paper resolving the uniqueness/classification of traces on the ideal $\mathfrak{P}_{r,2}^{\mathrm{APP}}{}_{r,\infty}$; related work by Pietsch and others addresses traces on Hilbert-space ideals and general frameworks but does not establish that the constructed traces exhaust all traces on this specific Banach-space ideal.

status_evidence.title: Traces on operator ideals and related linear forms on sequence ideals (part I)
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch's series on traces on operator ideals and linear forms on sequence ideals discusses general trace theory but does not resolve uniqueness for (P_{r,2})APP_{r,infty}.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of trace-uniqueness on the specific ideal is reported.

status_evidence.title: A New Approach to Operator Ideals on Hilbert Space and Their Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch develops trace theory on Hilbert-space operator ideals; the Banach-space setting of (P_{r,2})APP_{r,infty} is not addressed there.
status_evidence.claim: Related but does not solve the stated problem.
